selection_reason: Luna won the cross-judge head-to-head. Claude preferred Sol on three comments, chiefly for detached preservation constraints and the pronoun in the no-match boundary; all four judges found the differences small and tied at least 18 of 22 comments.
tradeoff: Explicit action grouping improved recall and scanability. Three judges scored naturalness slightly lower on average, although none selected the baseline as the better complete comment.
